pdMeasureRadioPower.toolTip: Requests the nominal radio setting without transmitting. Wait for radio readback before arming; actual output is measured separately.

pdMeasureApplyPower.accessibleDescription: Choose a different radio power setting first.

pdMeasurePowerStatus.value: Radio reports 5 W setting; actual RF output may differ.

pdMeasurePowerLimit.accessibleDescription: Does not change radio drive. Choose a limit above the nominal radio power setting and within your bench rating.

pdMeasureWindow.accessibleDescription: Window choice changes leakage and frequency resolution; no window guarantees a fixed measurable IMD depth.

pdMeasureAverages.accessibleDescription: One to four frames within the bounded source window. Averaging reduces estimate variance, not the physical noise floor.

pdMeasureOrder.accessibleDescription: Highest odd distortion product to analyze: three, five or seven.

pdMeasureTimeout.toolTip: Three to ten seconds from Transmit measurement, including startup. Short limits may end before capture completes. Expiry requests stop; confirmed RF release can occur later.

pdMeasureToneSpacing.accessibleDescription: 200 to 10000 Hz between tones, centered 1305 Hz above the carrier. Editing sends no command; Arm measurement source submits the pair.
